subject.title: Productividad: separar los tipos de operación de Picking y Packing en subtipos

question: Should productivity subtypes be implemented as visual-only derived grouping, persisted `metadata.operationSubtype`, or new first-class `operationType` enum values with migration/backfill decisions?
rationale: The code can support multiple approaches, and the reporter explicitly asked for lower-complexity options that avoid schema changes, so implementation would otherwise bake in a product/data-model choice.

options.title: Persist subtype in metadata
options.body: Keep `PICKING` and `PACKING` as operation types, add sanitized `metadata.operationSubtype`, and derive historical fallbacks where the source data is reliable.

options.title: Dashboard-only derivation
options.body: Compute subtypes only in the productivity report UI/API, accepting weaker filtering and incomplete historical accuracy when metadata is missing.

options.title: First-class operation types
options.body: Add enum values for each subtype and decide migration/backfill rules for existing generic sessions before implementation.

recommendation.title: Persist subtype in metadata
recommendation.body: Keep `PICKING` and `PACKING` as operation types, add sanitized `metadata.operationSubtype`, and derive historical fallbacks where the source data is reliable.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the key productivity code paths and is the reporter asking which lower-complexity product shape to use.
